id: # TV / audio source registry (ADR-0014). `device` is the SOURCE and is the only field that does anything:
#   url:<stream>     pull audio straight off the network with ffmpeg — headless, nothing playing on this box
#   pulse:<name>     a host audio input (records what THIS machine plays)
# Edit via the muni UI (TV / Audio -> Bind / Use URL) or by hand; the live copy is local/audio-sources.csv.
# The Bloomberg row uses Bloomberg's OWN published live manifest (bloomberg.com/media-manifest). If it stops
# working, replace the URL — availability is the broadcaster's to change, and per their terms this is for
# your own private analysis, never redistribution.
